openGraph.description: Get to know Hand in Hand – Your inclusive school companion in Hannover & Isernhagen. We accompany children with heart and mind. Contact us now!

parts.value: At Hand in Hand, we see your child as a personality – not as a diagnosis. In Hannover, Isernhagen, and the Hannover region, our school assistance enables self-determined participation in school life. We work with heart and mind, building bridges wherever support is needed.

blocks.alt: Two hands holding a small, green leaf. Symbolizes care and growth in school assistance.

parts.value: We accompany your child with autism, ADHD, as well as mental, social, or physical impairments – during lessons, breaks, and school activities. The goal is always: to strengthen independence and self-confidence so that genuine participation becomes possible.

As a small provider, we know our families. We coordinate closely with schools and authorities, with over 10 years of experience and a team that regularly undergoes further training. The pedagogical management is in the hands of a state-recognized educator and social pedagogue B.A. – for you, this means: professional and empathetic support from a single source.

We perceive every child in their uniqueness and adapt our support flexibly. For us, inclusion means: no one has to bend over backwards to belong. To achieve this, we communicate transparently with teachers and specialized agencies and pull together with you.

The path to school assistance can seem bureaucratic – we won't leave you alone. We explain processes, requirements, and support you in coordinating with the responsible authorities. Feel free to write to us if you need guidance.

Our pedagogical team brings high social competence and continuous further training. If you share „We see you“ as a lived attitude and would like to become active as a school companion in the region, we look forward to your application.

blocks.text: Hand in Hand for genuine participation

parts.value: Whether you are a family looking for relief or a professional seeking a meaningful job – with us, people come together who take inclusion seriously. Together, we make school a place where every child can unfold their strengths.

parts.value: "We see you" is the heart of Hand in Hand. As a school assistance and school support service in Hannover and Isernhagen, we support children with special challenges – such as autism, ADHD, or mental, social, and physical disabilities. We are not an anonymous provider: you get dedicated contact persons and support that is tailored to your child.

blocks.alt: Children playing hand in hand in the schoolyard

parts.value: Behind the school assistance is a dedicated team with very high social competence. Under the leadership of a state-recognized educator and social pedagogue B.A., we bring over 10 years of experience. Regular training and close exchange with schools keep our work up to date – for you, this means: warm-hearted and professional support.

Within the framework of school assistance and school support, our professionals are trusted confidants: they help with structure and tasks, promote positive interaction during breaks, and work hand in hand with you and the teachers. This creates an environment in which your child can feel safe and develop their strengths.

Every child is different. That is why we plan flexibly and precisely – whether for lessons, breaks, or special situations. We provide empathetic and competent support in Hannover and the surrounding area.
The path to school assistance can seem complex. We advise you on procedures and requirements and support you in coordinating with authorities and schools in the Hannover region.

Are you a pedagogical professional or a career changer who wants to help shape school assistance and school support in Hannover? We offer further training, dedicated contact persons, and a team at eye level. Feel free to apply with us.

For over 10 years, we have been supporting families in Hannover and the surrounding area. As a small provider, we know the stories behind the applications – and remain accessible to you when it matters.
